title: Move run.rs to run/mod.rs with no behavior change
summary: Structure pass R1: rename crates/athena-core/src/run.rs to run/mod.rs unchanged, so the `run` module path stays the same. The only text edits are the two test-module `include_str!` paths, which need one more `../`. The audience is the owner and verifier applying the section 5 proof.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check unchanged test list and passing builds, not file existence.
cargo test, clippy and fmt must pass.
Verifier runs the test list comparison and grep itself.
Test list comparison and grep show no behavior change.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Module path `run` is unchanged by the rename, so no re-exports are needed.
The two include_str! paths in the test module (athena.toml, defaults.toml) are the only non-import edits and are necessary because the file is one directory deeper.
Depends on the R0 test already being in run.rs; the move carries it along.
Prose mentions of run.rs elsewhere (comments, fixture strings) are left alone unless they are live path references.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-core/src/run.rs no longer exists and crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs holds its text; `git diff -M` shows a rename whose only changed lines are the include_str! paths gaining one `../`.

No file outside crates/athena-core/src/run/ names a moved item by an old module path: a Grep for `run::` and `mod run` over crates/ shows the same paths resolving, and `pub mod run;` in lib.rs is unchanged.
Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core -- --list` on the change and on the parent commit (git show / diff); the test names are identical in count and content.
`cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked` pass, and no `#[allow]` is added.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry saying run.rs became run/mod.rs with no behavior change.

out_of_scope: Splitting run/mod.rs into submodules (later structure-pass jobs)
Editing tests other than the two include_str! paths
departures: Mechanical rename; slightly higher pass chance, but the file is very large (3000+ lines) and the rename must be reproduced exactly.
